reasons.requirements: The spec and diff cover AC1–AC7: optional date on POST, set and clear on PATCH, 400 on invalid dates, the overdue filter, date display, the "überfällig" marker and the "nur überfällige" button.
reasons.scope: The change stays on the feature; the only extras are the `.gitignore` entry for `.playwright-mcp/` and committed spec and plan docs, which are minor.
reasons.tests: New tests cover POST and PATCH validation, setting and clearing the date, and an overdue filter with yesterday, today, tomorrow, no-date and done cases, and the existing deepEqual test was extended rather than weakened; the UI has no automated test beyond a manual E2E run.
reasons.conventions: The code uses `ValidationError` for HTTP 400, adds no dependencies, gives new UI elements a `data-testid`, and follows TDD; the E2E screenshots were saved in the repo's `.playwright-mcp/` directory instead of outside the repository as AGENTS.md requires.
reasons.architecture: Validation and filtering live in the store and `app.mjs` only passes the query parameter through; the UI repeats the overdue rule on the client, which the spec chose deliberately.
reasons.codeQuality: The code is clean and handles edge cases such as date round-tripping and null; `parseDueDate` throws the same error in two places, and the page computes `today` once at load so it goes stale in a long-open tab.
